hook: → 观点卡：AI资本开支与全球资本向美股集中
lines: The host notes a stark divergence in AI adoption urgency, with US business leaders aggressively integrating advanced models while European firms lag due to heavy regulatory hurdles.

The discussion highlights that the democratization of powerful AI models has triggered an exponential surge in sophisticated cyberattacks, exposing critical vulnerabilities in enterprise defense infrastructure.
Global equity diversification has reached historic lows, with international markets heavily concentrated around a narrow cohort of companies tied to the dominant US-centered AI trade.
Financial market infrastructure is increasingly acting as a geopolitical instrument, particularly in managing complex cross-border challenges such as frozen sovereign assets.
podcast: In Good Company with Nicolai Tangen
title: Friday Wrap-Up: Cyber Worries and Capital Flowing into the US
